design_note: Adds a small hypothesis-testing tree before plan authority. Equal symptom words lead to different next investigations when failure populations and dependency observations differ; no leaf authorizes remediation.

source.title: Effective Troubleshooting
source.concept: Troubleshooting develops competing explanations and tests their predicted observations. Correlated events alone do not establish causation; confirming and contradicting evidence should guide the next investigation.
source.scope: Original matched-request cases and diagnostic choices. The source supplies the troubleshooting principle, not a causal verdict or remediation authorization.

lesson.title: Use failure populations to test the story
lesson.intro: Constructed order-api cases have errors on new pods. Authorized telemetry covers matched requests and both revisions. Compare cases where only new pods fail with cases where both revisions fail.

data.root: Errors include new pods; compare both revisions

read: The branches partition these cases by observed revision coverage.
A degraded dependency changes the next test rather than settling causation.
Every leaf remains investigation; none grants rollback authority.
lesson.question: If only new pods fail and dependency checks pass, is rollback now proven correct and authorized?
lesson.answer: No. Those observations prioritize a new-version hypothesis within their coverage; they do not exclude every confounder or prove a remedy. Gather sufficient evidence for an immutable proposal. Rollback remains risk 4 with two distinct authorized privileged approvers and atomic live preconditions. Risk 5 stays blocked regardless of diagnostic confidence.
lesson.takeaway: Use observations to narrow the next test, then keep diagnosis separate from action authority.
lesson.assumption: Constructed complete matched-request cases; old-only and no-error populations are outside this tree. Dependency checks have a stated, limited scope.
